title: Every module has a free resolution, and a finite module over a Noetherian ring has a finite free one
author: The Stacks Project Authors
source_version: Stacks Project git a04446e57ec1 (2026-07-28); file algebra.tex; corpus local snapshot 20261012
difficulty_reason: The lemma produces an exact complex of free modules mapping onto any module M, and asserts that when R is Noetherian and M is finite the free modules may be taken finite (statement lines 17627-17643). The proof does not use projective covers or a minimal resolution: it builds the complex step by step, starting from a surjection onto M and then choosing a surjection onto the kernel of the last map already constructed, which can be kept finite exactly because over a Noetherian ring the kernel of a map between finite free modules is finitely generated (proof lines 17645-17652). The author states that only the Noetherian case is explained, and that explanation is the whole construction. H2.
